steps.name: Owner A exports v1 as a ZIP; every file matches the SHA-256 recorded at import; manifest included
the exported ZIP re-imports as a new project with byte-identical files (no GitHub, no Vercel)
Owner B, in another session, exports the same version with the same file hashes
outsider and anonymous cannot export (401 or redirect to login)
a version id that does not belong to the project is refused (404)
